definitions.name: read
definitions.description: Read a text file of the workspace, or look at an image. Shows at most 2000 lines or 50 KB at a time; when more is left, the result says which offset to continue from. offset is the first line to show (1-based), limit how many lines (at most 2000). A PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image (up to 3.75 MB and 8000 pixels a side) is returned as an image you can see; another binary file is reported, not shown. To see a directory, use ls.
